<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 720" width="1000" height="720" font-family="Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>

  <rect width="1000" height="720" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- ===== title ===== -->
  <text x="500" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#1a1a1a">Calculator App — Architecture</text>
  <text x="500" y="54" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">Amplify + ECS on EC2 + RDS Postgres | ap-southeast-2</text>

  <!-- ===== CI/CD lane ===== -->
  <rect x="30" y="76" width="940" height="112" rx="8" fill="#f9fafb" stroke="#d1d5db"/>
  <text x="46" y="96" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#6b7280">CI / CD</text>

  <!-- infra repo -->
  <rect x="46" y="106" width="150" height="66" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9ca3af"/>
  <text x="121" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1a1a1a">CI-CD-infra</text>
  <text x="121" y="145" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#6b7280">Terraform</text>
  <text x="121" y="160" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#6b7280">terraform apply</text>

  <!-- app repo -->
  <rect x="238" y="106" width="150" height="66" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9ca3af"/>
  <text x="313" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1a1a1a">backend-logic</text>
  <text x="313" y="145" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#6b7280">server.js + calculate.js</text>
  <text x="313" y="160" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#6b7280">Dockerfile</text>

  <!-- actions -->
  <rect x="430" y="106" width="180" height="66" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9ca3af"/>
  <text x="520" y="126" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1a1a1a">GitHub Actions</text>
  <text x="520" y="143" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#6b7280">npm test (9 tests)</text>
  <text x="520" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#6b7280">docker build → push</text>

  <!-- ECR -->
  <rect x="652" y="106" width="150" height="66" rx="6" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#f59e0b"/>
  <text x="727" y="132" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#92400e">ECR (private)</text>
  <text x="727" y="150" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#b45309">calculator-backend</text>
  <text x="727" y="164" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#b45309">:latest  :SHA</text>

  <!-- arrows in CI lane -->
  <path d="M 388 139 L 424 139" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <path d="M 610 139 L 646 139" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
  <path d="M 196 128 L 220 128 L 220 90 L 745 90 L 745 100" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 3" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrowgray)"/>
  <text x="470" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#9ca3af">creates ECR repo</text>

  <!-- ===== user ===== -->
  <rect x="46" y="248" width="130" height="60" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="111" y="272" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1a1a1a">User Browser</text>
  <text x="111" y="291" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#6b7280">HTML + JS</text>

  <!-- amplify -->
  <rect x="46" y="352" width="130" height="66" rx="6" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#3b82f6"/>
  <text x="111" y="376" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1e40af">AWS Amplify</text>
  <text x="111" y="393" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#1d4ed8">index.html</text>
  <text x="111" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#1d4ed8">static hosting</text>

  <path d="M 111 348 L 111 316" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrowblue)"/>
  <text x="122" y="336" font-size="9" fill="#1d4ed8">serves page</text>

  <!-- ===== VPC ===== -->
  <rect x="230" y="216" width="740" height="470" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="248" y="238" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#6d28d9">VPC</text>

  <!-- public subnet -->
  <rect x="252" y="252" width="694" height="120" rx="8" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#a78bfa" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
  <text x="268" y="272" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#6d28d9">Public subnet</text>

  <rect x="290" y="284" width="180" height="70" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed"/>
  <text x="380" y="308" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#5b21b6">ALB</text>
  <text x="380" y="325" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#6d28d9">listener :443 HTTPS</text>
  <text x="380" y="340" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#6d28d9">TLS terminates here</text>

  <rect x="520" y="284" width="170" height="70" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#a78bfa"/>
  <text x="605" y="313" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#5b21b6">NAT Gateway</text>
  <text x="605" y="332" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#6d28d9">outbound only</text>

  <rect x="740" y="284" width="170" height="70" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#a78bfa"/>
  <text x="825" y="313" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#5b21b6">Internet Gateway</text>
  <text x="825" y="332" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#6d28d9">inbound + outbound</text>

  <!-- private subnet app -->
  <rect x="252" y="392" width="694" height="150" rx="8" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#4ade80" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
  <text x="268" y="412" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#15803d">Private subnet — application</text>

  <rect x="290" y="424" width="620" height="102" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#22c55e"/>
  <text x="600" y="446" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#166534">ECS Cluster (EC2 launch type)</text>

  <rect x="316" y="458" width="270" height="54" rx="5" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#86efac"/>
  <text x="451" y="478" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#166534">EC2 instance (ASG)</text>
  <text x="451" y="497" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#15803d">task: node server.js  :5000</text>

  <rect x="614" y="458" width="270" height="54" rx="5" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#86efac"/>
  <text x="749" y="478" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#166534">EC2 instance (ASG)</text>
  <text x="749" y="497" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#15803d">task: node server.js  :5000</text>

  <!-- private subnet db -->
  <rect x="252" y="562" width="694" height="106" rx="8" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#fca5a5" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
  <text x="268" y="582" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#b91c1c">Private subnet — data</text>

  <rect x="440" y="594" width="320" height="60" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#ef4444"/>
  <text x="600" y="617" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#991b1b">RDS PostgreSQL  :5432</text>
  <text x="600" y="636" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#b91c1c">calculater_app — table: calculations</text>

  <!-- ===== traffic arrows ===== -->

  <!-- browser to ALB -->
  <path d="M 176 268 L 212 268 L 212 300 L 284 300" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrowred)"/>
  <text x="212" y="260" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#dc2626">fetch() HTTPS</text>

  <!-- ALB to ECS -->
  <path d="M 380 354 L 380 418" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrowred)"/>
  <text x="392" y="382" font-size="9" fill="#dc2626">HTTP :5000</text>
  <text x="392" y="394" font-size="9" fill="#dc2626">/health</text>

  <!-- ECS to RDS -->
  <path d="M 600 526 L 600 588" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrowred)"/>
  <text x="612" y="558" font-size="9" fill="#dc2626">TCP :5432</text>

  <!-- ECR to ECS -->
  <path d="M 802 139 L 940 139 L 940 470 L 890 470" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 3" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrowamber)"/>
  <text x="952" y="300" font-size="9" fill="#b45309" transform="rotate(90 952 300)">image pull via NAT</text>

  <!-- ===== security groups legend ===== -->
  <rect x="46" y="452" width="152" height="216" rx="8" fill="#f9fafb" stroke="#d1d5db"/>
  <text x="62" y="474" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#374151">Security groups</text>

  <text x="62" y="500" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5b21b6">ALB SG</text>
  <text x="62" y="515" font-size="9" fill="#6b7280">in: 443 from 0.0.0.0/0</text>

  <text x="62" y="542" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#166534">EC2 SG</text>
  <text x="62" y="557" font-size="9" fill="#6b7280">in: 5000 from ALB SG</text>

  <text x="62" y="584" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#991b1b">RDS SG</text>
  <text x="62" y="599" font-size="9" fill="#6b7280">in: 5432 from EC2 SG</text>

  <text x="62" y="628" font-size="9" fill="#9ca3af">Each layer allows only</text>
  <text x="62" y="641" font-size="9" fill="#9ca3af">the one in front of it.</text>
  <text x="62" y="654" font-size="9" fill="#9ca3af">Source = SG, not IP.</text>

  <!-- arrow defs -->
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L7,3 L0,6" fill="#6b7280"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrowgray" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L7,3 L0,6" fill="#9ca3af"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrowred" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L7,3 L0,6" fill="#dc2626"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrowblue" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L7,3 L0,6" fill="#3b82f6"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrowamber" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="7" refY="3" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L7,3 L0,6" fill="#f59e0b"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

</svg>
